keyword.en: electric 30 concrete pump 60 m 180 m which is vertical
keyword.zh: 电动30的60米和180米哪个是垂直

title.en: Height does not replace what to Read the Electric 30 Distance Pair lists
title.zh: 「高度」不能替换电动30的距离数对怎样读列出的数字

description.en: to Read the Electric 30 Distance Pair. 60 m stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Height.
description.zh: 电动30的距离数对怎样读。60 m仍在目录格子里。插图来自「高度」。

h1.en: Height does not replace what to Read the Electric 30 Distance Pair lists
h1.zh: 「高度」不能替换电动30的距离数对怎样读列出的数字

directAnswer.en: On the Electric 30 concrete pump, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai labels the fine-stone line as horizontal / vertical and lists 60 m / 180 m. The second number is larger, and the label still sets the order. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Height.
directAnswer.zh: 在电动30混凝土泵上，河北品锦机械在邢台把细石行标成水平/垂直，并写出 60 m / 180 m。第二行 13 骨料在同样的“先水平后垂直”标题下标出 20 m / 60 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Height。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Height: Height demonstration diagram. On the Electric 30 concrete pump, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai labels the fine-stone line as horizontal / vertical and lists 60 m / 180 m. The heading is 细石输送（水平/垂直）. That is not the fine-stone row. Electric 30 also lists 30 kW and 12–15 m³/h.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Height页上的Height demonstration diagram。在电动30混凝土泵上，河北品锦机械在邢台把细石行标成水平/垂直，并写出 60 m / 180 m。13骨料输送（水平/垂直）是 20 m / 60 m。

body.en: The second number is larger, and the label still sets the order. The value is 60 m / 180 m. Maximum aggregate size on the same page is ≤ 3 cm. Those entries do not change the distance order.
body.zh: 第二行 13 骨料在同样的“先水平后垂直”标题下标出 20 m / 60 m。第二行的 60 m 是水平，第一行的 60 m 也是水平。

body.en: A second row, aggregate-13, lists 20 m / 60 m under the same horizontal-then-vertical heading. Hebei Pinjin Machinery did not list a note telling you to reverse the pair when the vertical figure is larger. The 60 m in the second row is horizontal, while the 60 m in the first row is also horizontal. The machine is a concrete pump from Xingtai, not a reinterpretation of Electric 20.
body.zh: 不要为了看起来像电动20的 120 m / 40 m 而把数对对调。电动30还标出 30 kW 和 12–15 m³/h。

body.en: Do not swap the pair so that it looks like Electric 20's 120 m / 40 m. Aggregate-13 pumping (H / V) is 20 m / 60 m. They are not one entry.
body.zh: 河北品锦机械没有标出注记说垂直数字更大时要颠倒数对。这台机器是邢台的混凝土泵，不是对电动20的重新解释。

question.en: On this row: Is 180 m horizontal?

answer.en: No. On the fine-stone label, 180 m is the vertical figure. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Height.
answer.zh: 不是。在细石标题下，180 m 是垂直数字。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Height画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: What is the aggregate-13 pair?

answer.en: 20 m horizontal and 60 m vertical. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Height.
answer.zh: 水平 20 m，垂直 60 m。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Height画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Electric 30 list a 24 mm row?
question.zh: 电动30标出 24 mm 行吗？

answer.en: No. It lists two distance rows and a maximum aggregate of ≤ 3 cm. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Height.
answer.zh: 没有。它标出两行距离，以及最大骨料 ≤ 3 cm。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Height画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Should I reorder the numbers?

answer.en: No. Keep the shown order under the horizontal / vertical heading. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Height.
answer.zh: 不要。在水平/垂直标题下保持写出的顺序。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Height画面里印出的数字。
